nos.title: Prepare for Plumbing Installations and Maintenance

performance_criteria.text: Explain in detail the use of different tools, measuring & inspection device equipment, and fittings for plumbing.
Perform cutting deburring/filing, marking, and fixing operations using vice.
Assess the tool's material quality to ensure long-term use in demanding plumbing environments.
Check if the tool & fitting required for different pipe types and plumbing applications.
Ensure that the tool includes necessary safety features to prevent injuries during use.
Ensure that the pipes are installed correctly, with minimal short turns, correct distances, and optimal use of space.
Verify that hot and cold-water lines are correctly laid and insulated where necessary to prevent heat loss.
Interpret the position of the fixtures and their accessories for supply and drainage systems
Understand hot & cold-water piping lay out in the building.
Ensure correct pipe -size/dia / type are used to get the required pressure & flow rate for water supply system.
Ensure correct usage pipe size & fitting the pipe with correct slope to install drainage system
Ensure that all plumbing fixtures (sinks, toilets, showers) are positioned according to the architectural plan, with proper spacing for usability and maintenance.
Ensure that each fixture has clearly indicated connection points for water supply.
Check the drainage system for proper venting, position of traps & anti siphonage to prevent breaking of water seals
Collect required plumbing material -type, size, and quantities based on specifications from drawings and plans.
Check if the tools and equipment are functioning properly and inform the relevant authority in case of any deviation.
Clear the area of hazardous substances, debris, and waste as per organizational norms
Store collected materials to be used in a secure manner to ensure there is no spillage or cross-contamination.
place signages and barricades as required to ensure safety and security of the work area, workers, and visitors
plan tasks in agreement with others while adhering to time commitments.
Study a typical water distribution system and identify its different components.
Explain in detail the hot-water and cold-water distribution/circulation system.
Inspect typical solar water heater system and demonstrate its different components with its applications.
Identify & select the fitting requirements to install the pipes
measure and mark dimensions for installation of the pipes and fittings base on site condition making allowances for finale finishing
Cut various types of pipes to the required length.
Cut threads on G I pipe as required.
Bend and form the pipes to specified angles and offsets.
prepare pipe ends using techniques such as reaming, deburring, levelling, filing, and grinding
Join different types of pipes using fittings and with specified techniques.
Ensure the assembled pipe meets the required specifications
Report any issues/ difficulties that may arise.
Install the assembled pipe fittings and other water supply components
identify the area and route where the assembled pipes are to be installed
perform wall chasing, drilling, and nailing on a range of building materials such as brickwork, concrete, block work, timber, etc.
install pipes and other water supply components according to given specifications and site requirements without damage or interference to the surrounding structures
finish the cut area of the wall after installing pipes and other water supply components
check if all the water supply system installations are properly aligned, sized, supported, and installed properly
identify and rectify faults that are within limits of expertise and authority and escalate others to authorized personnel
clear the work area and dispose, reuse, or recycle leftover materials according to regulations and, codes of practice
clean and store tools and equipment according to manufacturer’s recommendations and workplace procedures
identify the type of drainage piping systems and its components to be installed as appropriate for the type of building
use plumbing project plans to determine the location of various drainage components and the route of the water drainage piping and traps
calculate quantity, dimensions and type of materials required from design drawings/specifications
construct chambers to accommodate drainage systems
determine fitting requirements for installing various types of drainage pipes according to given specifications and site requirements
check if the area is prepared for laying the pipes for underground, above ground and overhead piping systems
install the various components of drainage system such as various pipes and their fittings, manholes, traps, cleanouts, catch basins, inspection chamber, soak pit etc.
perform fitting activities on various types of pipes such as stoneware (SW) pipes, polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes etc.
install stormwater and sub-soil drainage system
install different types of pumps used in sanitary and drainage systems such as submersible water pumps, dewatering pumps (for rainwater piping) etc.
install pipework for water and sewage treatment plant
test the installations for proper functioning
repair faulty drainage pipes and traps
ensure that all inspection openings and covers are fitted according to relevant standards and job specifications
backfill excavated areas to secure the installation
put required signages at the site after the plumbing task has been completed
clear the work area and dispose, reuse or recycle left over materials according to legislation, regulations, codes of practice and job specification
clean and store tools and equipment according to manufacturer’s recommendations and workplace procedures
Plan the correct fixtures requirement, parts, and support material provided in the packing with the manufacturer’s list or order form.
select the size, type, and quantity of fixture and trim for specific applications according to the given specifications
locate and mark the position of fixtures and fixture supports in structures
Ensure fixtures are level and securely fastened. Tighten connections without over- tightening, which can damage the fittings.
cut the physical structures such as walls, and concrete in line with the correct markings and specifications for performing internal pipe installations
install supports for plumbing piping using correct tool to ensure grade, spacing, and alignment
install fixtures as per specifications without damage to pipework, the surrounding area.
Install and secure the sensor for touchless fittings and fixtures in the slot provided slot.
insert batteries for sensor-based fittings and fixtures safely and in compliance with the manufacturer’s specifications
connect fixture to water supply, drainage and electricity supply & ensuring proper functioning, safety and compliance to manufacturer’s specifications
perform installation of smart plumbing fixtures.
Perform Installation of smart sensors and automated systems to monitor and control water flow, temperature, and energy usage in real-time.
plumb and level the supports and fixtures installed to ensure alignment and balance
check if all installations are properly aligned, supported and functioning
identify and rectify/ replace faults that are within limits of expertise and authority and escalate others to authorized personnel
clear the work area and dispose, reuse or recycle left over materials according to regulations and codes of practice
Handover to customer with full information and warranty card of products.

nos.title: Perform Troubleshooting and Maintenance for Domestic Plumbing Fixtures and Systems

performance_criteria.text: Detect root cause for problem
detect blockages and damage in pipes, fitting and fixtures
detect reason for low flow low pressure
Replace faulty pipe fitting & parts
remove air lock and blockages in the pipes that are installed
repair and maintain water supply tanks and valves
unclog drains and drain’s strainer baskets
repair broken sewer, dripping faucets and fixtures that are not working properly
resolve leakages, loosening and jamming of fittings
implement measures to reduce noise in pipes and fixtures
inspect and maintain the septic systems on a timely basis
perform basic services for appliances such as water heaters, washing machines and dishwashers etc.
clean up spills quickly after the task has been completed
empty waste containers as per organizational procedures
discard oily rags and flammable materials as per industry practices
record daily logs in a specified format for activities such as maintenance and installation
guide customers on proper care and maintenance of plumbing systems
Minimize water usage by using water-efficient fixtures and appliances.
Apply water leak prevention techniques
Use low toxicity and environment friendly materials
Maintain optimal water pressure to prevent waste and damage to the system.
Perform Insulation on pipes carrying hot water to minimize energy loss and improve efficiency.
Use locally sourced materials and prefabricated components to reduce transportation energy, and choose products with a lower carbon footprint.
Ensure that the plumbing system complies with relevant green building standards like LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) or Green Building Certification.

nos.title: Apply Health and Safety Practices at the Workplace

performance_criteria.text: identify risks and hazards at the workplace
wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as per the type of plumbing work
place protective barricades and signages around the pits and trenches
isolate the plumbing fittings and fixtures from electrical wiring to avoid accidents
adhere to organizational procedures for reporting hazards and incidents to relevant authorities
establish ventilation before entering underground work areas
work safely in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas
ensure tools and hazardous materials are not left unattended
ensure good housekeeping in order to prevent hazards e.g. fire
dispose waste materials and used PPE according to regulations and codes of practice
follow recommended personal hygiene and sanitation practices, for example, washing/sanitizing hands, covering face with a bent elbow while coughing/sneezing etc.
clean and disinfect work area, materials/supplies, equipment etc. before and after use.
report hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
check that the tools, equipment and materials are in good condition and as per industry standards before use
use power tools and machinery that are grounded
replace or repair split or loose tools before use
store and transport various plumbing materials safely
follow workplace emergency and evacuation procedures
use a fire extinguisher correctly
use safe methods to free a person from electrocution
administer appropriate first aid (such as CPR etc.) to victims in case of cuts, bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock, poisoning etc
understand the significance of employability skills in meeting the job requirements
identify constitutional values, civic rights, duties, personal values and ethics and environmentally sustainable practices

explain 21st Century Skills such as Self- Awareness, Behavior Skills, Positive attitude, self-motivation, problem-solving, creative thinking, time management, social and cultural awareness, emotional awareness, continuous learning mindset etc.
speak with others using some basic English phrases or sentences
follow good manners while communicating with others
work with others in a team
communicate and behave appropriately with all genders and PwD
report any issues related to sexual harassment
use various financial products and services safely and securely
calculate income, expenses, savings etc.
approach the concerned authorities for any exploitation as per legal rights and laws
operate digital devices and use its features and applications securely and safely
use internet and social media platforms securely and safely
identify and assess opportunities for potential business
identify sources for arranging money and associated financial and legal challenges
identify different types of customers
identify customer needs and address them appropriately
follow appropriate hygiene and grooming standards
create a basic biodata
search for suitable jobs and apply
identify and register apprenticeship opportunities as per requirement

nos.title: Perform Installation of Insulation on Pipes

performance_criteria.text: Identify different types of insulation materials like fibre glass, mineral wood, foam insulation, cellulose, etc.
identify different types of covering for the protection of insulation material.
identify different types of fasteners and joints.
identify different types of sealings and jointing material.
identify the accessories such as insulation hanger, insulation saddle, etc.
identify the different types and grade of pipes
identify the different types of measuring devices
identify the different types of cutting and sealing devices.
identify the irregularities in pipe diameter, shape, or surface condition and rectify it.
ensure proper alignment and sealing of insulation joints.
perform different techniques for cutting such as nesting or pattern cutting to maximize the number of usable pieces from each insulation sheet or roll.
perform clean and smooth cutting of edges of insulation material to facilitate proper sealing and adhesion during installation.
avoid ragged or jagged edges
identify the correct measurement of material with required instruments.
calculate the desired thickness of insulation material based on pipe diameter.
perform checking of thermal conductivity, density and durability.
perform tightly fit of insulation material around the pipes.
Ensure complete coverage of the pipe, including bends, joints, and fittings.
perform secured sealing of seams, joints, and edges of insulation to prevent air leakage and moisture ingress.
